description: Upload project images (png/jpg/webp/gif/svg), and with models: true 3D models (.glb), so they appear in the Inventor Studio Assets tab. Only new or changed files upload. Omit dirs to use .inventor.json "assets.include".

dirs.description: Folders relative to the project root

models.description: Also upload .glb 3D models, from the dirs given (or .inventor.json "assets.models" when dirs are omitted). New models are team-only; an image <model>.poster.webp next to one is its thumbnail

name: inventor_push_assets
